SELECT 
    t1.assessment_type,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.date_submitted > t1.date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(t2.id_student), 1) AS late_submission_percentage
FROM assessments AS t1
JOIN studentAssessment AS t2 ON t1.id_assessment = t2.id_assessment
WHERE t1.date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t1.assessment_type;
